name: InfographicVQA
intro: InfographicVQA 是面向复杂信息图的视觉问答数据集，包含 5,485 张图像和 30,035 个问题，要求联合理解 OCR 文本、布局、图形、表格、地图和基础算术。
org: IIIT Hyderabad, IISER Pune, CVC / Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona
build_method: 网页信息图检索，两轮去重，受训内部标注者两阶段问答标注，图像级划分与质量过滤
task_type: 信息图视觉问答, OCR, 文档推理
eval_feature: 答案来源、证据类型、计数/排序/算术操作
task_type_en: Infographic visual QA, OCR, document reasoning
build_method_en: Web infographic retrieval, two-stage deduplication, two-stage QA annotation by trained internal annotators, image-disjoint splitting, and quality filtering
eval_feature_en: Answer source, evidence type, counting/sorting/arithmetic operations
intro_en: InfographicVQA is a visual question-answering dataset for complex infographics. Its 5,485 images and 30,035 questions require joint reasoning over OCR text, layout, graphics, tables, maps, and elementary arithmetic.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2104.12756v2 and the WACV 2022 publication; official data and OCR assets are distributed through the DocVQA InfographicVQA page and RRC challenge rather than a versioned code repository. The authors download more than 10,000 Google and Bing images. Perceptual hashing removes nearly 2,000 duplicates, then Amazon Textract OCR tokens and Jaccard similarity perform a second deduplication, leaving about 7,000 candidates. A crowd pilot produces more than 40% noisy submissions, so candidates instead attend a 90-minute webinar, pass a quiz, and 13 internal annotators are selected. Stage 1 permits image rejection and collects more than 30k questions. Image-disjoint train/validation/test splits are about 80/10/10. On validation and test, a different worker independently supplies a second answer without seeing the first and may flag cannot-answer. Rules remove 1.9% cannot-answer questions, lowercase and deduplicate references, and accept multi-span permutations. The final release has 30,035 questions over 5,485 images from 2,594 domains, with 23,946/2,801/3,288 questions and 4,406/500/579 images. ANLS and exact accuracy are deterministic: lowercase, best reference, and a 0.5 similarity cutoff. Human performance is ANLS 0.980 and exact accuracy 95.70. Amazon Textract supplies OCR annotations; there is no generative judge.
